How Claude Evolved, 2023–2026

From one chat model in March 2023 to model families, a developer platform, an agent harness and products for coding, science, design and whole industries. Every Anthropic announcement this site tracks, laid out in seven lanes. Press play to watch it grow, hide lanes, or tap any dot.

Tap a dot

Each dot is one announcement. Big dots are flagship releases. The coloured bands behind are the four phases.

Dates, titles and summaries come from this site’s Frontier Lab Updates data, each with a link to its source. The lanes and the four phases are our grouping. Disclosure: Claude, made by Anthropic, helps write this site, so this is Anthropic’s own history drawn with Claude’s help.
